notes.title: Mononeko New Trailer!
notes.content:
It’s been a while since we’ve given a major update on our game. We are a small team, and it’s true that we haven’t been as active as we could be, but we can promise that this project is still alive, & that we’re working hard with the tools that we have. The game has changed a lot over the past few months, but we really hope you enjoy the sweet & bloody quest that we've been cooking up! 

This being said… we are happy to announce that we have a NEW TRAILER! 

You can check it out on Youtube over here: 

[previewyoutube=n3K_rGKVWwk;full][/previewyoutube]

Soon enough, we will also be opening up sign-ups for LIMITED-TIME PLAYTESTS!
